description:
As a new visitor, I want to create an account so I can place orders.

* All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it.
* An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
* Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors.
* A customer under 18 years old cannot register.
** Required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.
** Password must be at least 8 characters.
** Age is calculated from date of birth; under 18 → "You must be at least 18 years old."

criteria.text: All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it.
An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors.
A customer under 18 years old cannot register.

cases.title: Register with all required fields filled with valid data
cases.preconditions: The registration page is open. <an email address that is not already registered> is available.
steps: Enter a first name and a last name.
Enter a date of birth of <an applicant aged 18 or older>.
Enter the email address that is not already registered.
Enter a password of at least 8 characters.
Submit the registration form.
cases.expected: The account is created (the exact confirmation wording is not specified in the story).

cases.title: Sign in with the newly registered account
cases.preconditions: An account has been created through the registration form with all required fields valid; its email address and password are known to the tester.
steps: Open the sign-in page.
Enter the email address and password used at registration.
Submit the sign-in form.
cases.expected: The user is signed in with the registered account.

cases.title: Register with an already-registered email address
cases.preconditions: <an email address belonging to an existing registered customer> is known.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter a first name, a last name and a date of birth of an applicant aged 18 or older.
Enter the email address of the existing registered customer.
Enter a password of at least 8 characters.
Submit the registration form.
cases.expected: A clear error is shown (the exact text is not specified in the story) and no duplicate account is created for that email address.

cases.title: Invalid email format shows an inline validation error
steps: Enter a first name, a last name and a date of birth of an applicant aged 18 or older.
Enter <a string that is not a valid email format, for example one with no "@"> in the email field.
Enter a password of at least 8 characters.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown on the email field (the exact text is not specified in the story) and no account is created.

cases.title: Password below the minimum length shows an inline validation error
cases.preconditions: The registration page is open. <an email address that is not already registered> is available.
steps: Enter a first name, a last name and a date of birth of an applicant aged 18 or older.
Enter the email address that is not already registered.
Enter a password of 7 characters.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown on the password field (the exact text is not specified in the story) and no account is created.

cases.title: Password of exactly 8 characters is accepted
cases.preconditions: The registration page is open. <an email address that is not already registered> is available.
steps: Enter a first name, a last name and a date of birth of an applicant aged 18 or older.
Enter the email address that is not already registered.
Enter a password of exactly 8 characters.
Submit the registration form.
cases.expected: No password-length validation error is shown and the account is created.

cases.title: Applicant under 18 cannot register
cases.preconditions: The registration page is open. <an email address that is not already registered> is available.
steps: Enter a first name and a last name.
Enter a date of birth that gives an age under 18 as calculated from today's date.
Enter the email address that is not already registered.
Enter a password of at least 8 characters.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: The message "You must be at least 18 years old." is shown and no account is created.

cases.title: Date of birth one day before the 18th birthday is rejected
cases.preconditions: The registration page is open. <an email address that is not already registered> is available.
steps: Enter a first name and a last name.
Enter a date of birth exactly 18 years ago minus one day, so the 18th birthday falls tomorrow.
Enter the email address that is not already registered.
Enter a password of at least 8 characters.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: Registration is refused with the message "You must be at least 18 years old." and no account is created.

cases.title: Date of birth exactly on the 18th birthday is accepted
cases.preconditions: The registration page is open. <an email address that is not already registered> is available.
steps: Enter a first name and a last name.
Enter a date of birth exactly 18 years ago today.
Enter the email address that is not already registered.
Enter a password of at least 8 characters.
Submit the registration form.
cases.expected: No age error is shown, because the applicant is not under 18, and the account is created.

cases.title: A required field left empty
cases.preconditions: The registration page is open. <an email address that is not already registered> is available.
steps: Leave <one of the required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password> empty.
Fill every other required field with valid data.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: The account is not created because a required field is missing (the exact message or behaviour is not specified in the story).
